persons.name: Svāmin
persons.evidence: likhitam idam apūrvaṃ kośakāṃḍatriśeṣaṃ muninamivaryyāḥ svāmināmtaḥ sute(2)na

date.as_written: saṃvat 1863 vaiśākhamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe 13 (also: nabhasi bahulapakṣe vāsare sūryasūno)

notes: The scribe's identity in 'muninamivaryyāḥ svāmināmtaḥ sutena' is corrupt and uncertain. The place 'śrīviśvanāthopakaṃṭhe' refers to the vicinity of the Viśvanātha temple in Varanasi. An earlier metrical date mentions the month Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa) and Saturday (sūryasūno vāsare), while the final prose date records Saṃvat 1863 Vaiśākha kṛṣṇa 13.
